description.value: Nevados is a Latin American-inspired tapas restaurant and tequila lounge in downtown Fernie, BC, with over a decade of operation on a no-reservations, first-come-first-served basis. The kitchen works from scratch on small shared plates alongside an extensive agave spirits program featuring tequila and mezcal. Regular live music nights and themed weekly events make it a lively stop in Fernie's downtown core.
